instruction: Make me a spotify account with yearly premium membership.
notes: The supervisor has no Spotify account, so the plan creates one with the supervisor's own first/last name and email (read via supervisor.show_profile) and an agent-chosen password. AppWorld signup emails a verification code, which the agent must read from the supervisor's Gmail (gmail.login with the supervisor's email as username and the gmail password from show_account_passwords, then show_inbox_threads/show_thread) before spotify.verify_account; spotify.login requires a verified account (if the signup response does not send a code, spotify.send_verification_code can be called first). Premium needs a payment card registered in Spotify, so card details are fetched with supervisor.show_payment_cards and added via spotify.add_payment_card (its returned payment_card_id binds supervisor-card), then spotify.subscribe_premium with duration 'yearly'. The duration value is a domain constant so the goal can demand (premium-subscribed spotify yearly) and complete-task can check it. Goal mirrors the evaluation: one new spotify.User with the supervisor's name/email and one new 12-month PremiumSubscription; the Gmail/file-system changes are side effects of the verification email and the subscription receipt. complete_task takes no answer since the task is not a question.

plan: (spotify-add-payment-card card-name-1 owner-name-chris-mccoy card-number-1 expiry-year-1 expiry-month-1 cvv-number-1 gmail-token supervisor-card)
